title: UUIDv2 (DCE Security)
summary: UUID version 2 (DCE Security) reuses the v1 layout but replaces the low 32 bits of the timestamp with a POSIX UID or GID, and the clock sequence high bits with the ID type (UID/GID/group). It is rarely used and largely superseded by v7.

notes: time_low holds a POSIX UID or GID instead of the low 32 bits of the timestamp.
Clock sequence high bits encode the ID type (0 = user, 1 = group, 2 = org).
Largely obsolete; prefer UUIDv7 for new systems.
